changelog: JellyTrack Plugin v2.0.0.2: Advanced security audit and hardening release. Extended SSRF protection against cloud metadata endpoints (Alibaba IMDS, Azure, subdomains and wildcard DNS evasion), unhandled exception resilience in background worker, boundary checks on administrative test endpoints, and response stream sanitization.
description: JellyTrack is an analytics dashboard for Jellyfin. This plugin intercepts playback events, library changes and sends a periodic heartbeat to the JellyTrack server.
name: JellyTrack
overview: Jellyfin plugin to push playback events to JellyTrack
